We have worked in the areas of hospitality, offices and residential buildings, developing exclusive identities for each project. The projects are styled by its responsive and aesthetic impression, and the constant exploration for something novel.

The design process and site execution are lead by Co founders
Ar. Siddhi Kapadia & Ar. Jay Kapadia.

featured_reviews.name: Tanvi Desai
featured_reviews.review_text:
I dont have enought words to show my gratitude for the work Design elephants has done. Jay and Siddhi were literally God sent for us. This was my parents home and they are both retired senior citizens. I was so worried about how my dad will handle the chaos of workers management and design selection and material selection. But the whole process was a breeze. They understood what vision my parents had and designed the whole house around it. There were so many instances where they absolutely exceeded expectations. Points we missed which we would have later regretted while living in the house were all highlighted and covered. The workers management was seamless. Thier teams be it painters or carpenters or other were very nice and skilled.
The building was a redeveloped property and so many simultaneous home interior were on going. When I saw and compared our experience with others, I realised we were truly lucky to work with Jay and Siddhi. No chaos, no disruption. And all timeliness met.

Cant thank them enough. Stay blessed always.
